title: SV Werder Bremen GmbH & Co KG aA | EuroCham
content: #### Company Profile. Founded on 4 February 1899, the club is based in the Hanseatic city of Bremen, with its iconic Weserstadion beautifully located on the banks of the River Weser.Competing in Germany’s top division, the Bundesliga, Werder Bremen is among the league’s most successful and established clubs. Its fierce and historic rivalry with Hamburger SV, known as the Nordderby, remains one of German football’s classic encounters.Today, with more than 62,000 members, Werder Bremen is the largest sports club in Bremen and ranks among the leading clubs in Germany. It combines professional football with a broad sports base, emphasizing both performance and community spirit.SV Werder Bremen has a huge interest in Vietnam, is active in the market since 2019, and engages through various events within the community.
